description: Implementation of the D3D9 VertexBuffer class for managing vertex buffers in Direct3D 9 within the ANGLE graphics library.

classes.name: rx::VertexBuffer9
classes.description: A class managing a Direct3D 9 vertex buffer, including initialization, data storage, resizing, and discarding.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Allocates and initializes the vertex buffer with specified size and usage.

methods.name: storeVertexAttributes
methods.description: Stores vertex attribute data into the buffer, with optional conversion.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the current size of the vertex buffer.

methods.name: setBufferSize
methods.description: Resizes the buffer if the new size is larger than the current size.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Discards the current contents of the buffer by locking and unlocking with D3DLOCK_DISCARD.
